You kneel close, steady the trembling hands or bind the hurt, and talk your companion through the next breath.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing creature.
Duration
Immediate reduction and possible movement.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature

Choose one temporary condition on the target: Bleeding, Frightened or Poisoned. Reduce only that condition, minimum 0.

Weak
Reduce it by 1.
Standard
Reduce it by 2.
Strong
Reduce it by 3; the target may also move 1 square without provoking if able.

This restores no HP and does not remove starred sources or wound scars.

Additional rulings
